definitions: The cardinal number following twenty and preceding twenty-two.
A playing card game, also known as blackjack, in which the object is to obtain cards with a face value totaling as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it.
The age at which a person is considered an adult and is legally permitted to consume alcohol in the United States.
examples: He drew a ten and an ace, making twenty-one.
The legal drinking age is twenty-one.
